name: text-input
purpose: Single-line text entry built on a native <input>, with label, required indicator, help text, localized constraint validation, optional character counter, text addons, and sensitive-input support (password reveal, clipboard policy).
whenToUse: Short free-text values: names, email addresses, URLs, phone numbers, passwords, search terms.
Fields that need consistent, localized validation messages across browsers.
Values with a fixed prefix or suffix, such as a URL scheme or a unit.
whenNotToUse: Numbers users may step or that need locale-aware parsing: use Number Input.
Choosing from a known list: use Select, Combobox, or Radio Group.
Dates and times: use Date Input or Date Picker.
responsive: Full width of its container; addons do not wrap and the input shrinks (min-inline-size 0). Density tokens adjust the control height.
rtl: Logical properties: prefix sits at the inline start and suffix at the inline end in both directions.
theme: Control surface, border, focus, error, and sunken-surface role tokens. Focus is shown on the control boundary with a 1px ring plus border color. Forced-colors mode draws a Highlight outline on focus.
security: Label, help text, addons, and messages are rendered with textContent. Validation messages never include the entered value. Password inputs default to autocomplete=current-password and spellcheck off; the clipboard policy can block copy/cut or all clipboard access. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. The native input carries the value for form submission when `name` is set.

performance.testedScale: 1,000 inputs on one page in the performance test.

limitations: `maxLength` is validated, not enforced by truncation: users can paste long text and correct it (GOV.UK character-count pattern).
Lengths are counted in Unicode code points; grapheme clusters such as flag emoji count as more than one.
The clipboard policy is a deterrent, not a security boundary: browser extensions and developer tools can still read the value.
Input masking (phone, card numbers) is not available.
unsupported: Rendering HTML in the label, help text, addons, or messages.
antiPatterns: Using the placeholder as the only label.
Showing errors while the user is still typing the first time (keep validationTiming 'blur').
Blocking paste into password fields; it prevents password managers.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/text-input: AuiTextInput directive ([auiTextInput]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/text-input: AuiTextInput component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
